description:
Prototype zero-copy access privately inside the measurement harness and test whether avoided copying benefits a real mid-range consumer.

## Background

`BitSlice` remains an offset bit view with bit accessors, not a borrowed-word API. This study does not add public methods, change layout, or adopt a production path. Its adapter must make alignment, bit offset, logical length, and tail masking costs visible.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A private prototype covers the predeclared consumer cell without exposing a new public borrowed-word surface or bypassing canonical logical semantics.
- [hard] REQ-02: Exact results hold for empty, aligned, deliberately offset, and 0/1/63/64/65 boundary cases with zero tail padding.
- [hard] REQ-03: The receipt reports copy-inclusive and prototype costs, adjusted confidence bounds, equivalence results, complexity accounting, and preserved negative or inconclusive outcomes.

## Notes

Only qualifying consumer evidence can reach a separately reviewed integration design; this issue itself cannot authorize API work.
title: Measure a private BitSlice zero-copy prototype
